# Keen.io

Keen.io is an embedded analytics API that enables developers to collect, analyze, and visualize event data seamlessly.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/keen-io/.

## Actions

- **Inspect All Event Collections** (read-only): Retrieve schema info for all event collections.
- **Inspect Single Event Collection** (read-only): Retrieve schema info for a single event collection.
- **List Cached Dataset Definitions** (read-only): List cached dataset definitions for a project.
- **Select Unique** (read-only): Return unique values for a target property.
- **Unrevoke Access Key**: Unrevoke (reactivate) a specific access key.
- **Inspect Collection Property** (read-only): Return details for a specific property in an event collection.
